title: Scorecard attestation and rollout conductor for mixed-traffic experiments
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Problem: We currently rely on simple threshold checks for a single golden prompt set during canaries. This ticket implements a more robust attestation layer: a scorecard attestor that evaluates model responses against multiple golden prompt partitions (tiny, common, customer-tailored) with weighted fingerprints and a rollout conductor that applies debounced automatic rollback policies for mixed traffic (shadow + canary + A/B).

Scope:
- Build a lightweight attestation service that subscribes to canary/AB/ shadow streams and computes per-batch scorecards (accuracy, token-level regressions, hallucination flags, latency penalty).
- Support weighted golden partitions and runtime reweighting per customer segment.
- Implement a rollout conductor that ingests scorecard signals, applies hysteresis (debounce window) and probabilistic quarantine before triggering rollbacks.
- Expose per-rollout dashboards and alerting hooks, and document safe defaults.

Out of scope: full evaluation infra for offline evals, model training changes, or reassigning golden prompts by ML research (those will be handled via separate PRD).
acceptance_criteria: Attestor service available behind feature flag and receives 95% of canary request/response events in test clusters
Scorecards computed per 1k requests or every 30s (whichever comes first) and persisted for 30 days
Rollback conductor enforces: immediate quarantine if composite score drops > 10% vs baseline OR sustained degradation > 3% for 3 windows
Dashboard shows per-partition breakdown and weighted composite score; alerts when rollback policy would trigger
Unit and integration tests for attestation logic with synthetic golden partitions and injected regressions
Runbook updated and SLO for false-positive rollback rate established (< 1% on staged runs)
tasks: Design attestation schema and weighted partition contract (Arjun)
Implement streaming consumer and scorecard aggregator (backend)
Add in-memory KV for short-term fingerprint caching to avoid duplicate evaluations
Implement conductor state machine and hysteresis/debounce logic
Wire alerts to Ops pager and add opt-in Slack channel notifications
Create dashboard panels in Console and link to rollout pages
End-to-end tests with shadowed traffic and synthetic regressions
Documentation: design doc, runbook, and config knobs for customers
